quotes.text: Our 2026 operating plan to turn around the U.S. business and accelerate growth internationally is on track.
quotes.by: Steve Cahillane, CEO of Kraft Heinz

outlook: Adjusted EPS (1)(2) is now expected to be in the range of $2.07 to $2.13.

Additionally, the Company expects an effective tax rate on Adjusted EPS of approximately 23.5%, interest expense of approximately $890 million, and other expense/(income) of approximately $210 million of income for the full year.

items.heading: Our success depends on our ability to correctly predict, identify, and interpret changes in consumer preferences and demand, to offer new products to meet those changes, and to respond to competitive innovation.
Changes in the retail landscape or the loss of key retail customers could adversely affect our financial performance.
Changes in our relationships with significant customers or suppliers, or in other business relationships, could adversely impact us.
We may be unable to drive revenue growth in our key product categories or platforms, increase our market share, or add products that are in faster-growing and more profitable categories.
Product recalls or other product liability claims could materially and adversely affect us.
Changes in environmental conditions and responsive legislation or regulation may have a long-term adverse impact on our business and results of operations.
